text:
ella: Quick check  were debating left rail vs stacked cards for org billing. Also one wild idea: a collapsible bottom drawer for exports & invoices. Thoughts?
noah: Left rail for desktop, stacked for narrow screens. Bottom drawer feels like a modal substitute  could be nice for quick actions.
samir: Bottom drawer could be great for prominent invoice actions (download, email, dispute) without masking charts. But mobile swiping could conflict.
ari: Accessibility note: drawer must be announced by screen readers when opened (use aria-modal or role=dialog), and trap focus.
access-bot: Accessibility check: ensure skip link to main content if using left rail; for drawer use aria-hidden on background and use focus trap.
ella: Copy nit: current label "Tokens" confuses some customers. Suggest "Compute tokens (usage units)" or "Compute units" in some spots.
noah: +1 on "Compute units" especially next to dollar amounts.
samir: Chart/layout idea: keep a narrow left rail with filters + pinned scope, stack token breakdown as an expandable card to the right. That way we get pinned controls and better mobile fallback.
ari: If we keep colors for projects, add high-contrast patterns (diagonals/dots) for colorblind support; also ensure legend is keyboard-focusable.
access-bot: Contrast alert: small token badge text at 11px fails AA on our palette. Options: increase size, bold text, or add a 1.5-2px outline.
ella: Export UX: primary CTA "Download invoice" should open a small menu: PDF / CSV / Line items. Consider remembering user's last choice per org.
samir: Analytics: track format selection and whether users use the drawer vs modal. Add event names: billing.export.initiated, billing.export.format_selected.
noah: Keyboard behavior: if using left rail, make the rail focusable via a shortcut (G then B?) and ensure Tab order flows logical -> left rail -> charts -> timeline -> footer.
ari: Reduced-motion: all expand/collapse animations need prefers-reduced-motion respect. Also make expand affordances visible (chevron rotates).
ella: Mobile fallback: stacked cards with a sticky compact scope chip at top that opens the drawer for export. Keeps the top of the page uncluttered.
samir: Invoices: some customers expect PDF by default  maybe default to PDF but surface CSV prominently for finance teams.
access-bot: Invoice modal guidance: heading format "Invoice April 2026  Redwood Inference" and include aria-describedby summarizing what's included (totals, line items, tax).
noah: UX microcopy: replace "Switch scope" with tabs: "Account | Project" and add a small tooltip "scope determines which teams usage youre viewing".
ella: Action items: samir  prototype narrow rail + expandable token card; noah  keyboard shortcut + tab flow prototype; ari  accessibility checklist + aria snippets; I'll draft microcopy for tabs and export menu. 20m sync after mocks? :clock10:
samir: Will get a clickable mock today.
ari: Will post ARIA snippets and pattern fills by EOD.
noah: Shortcut prototype by tomorrow morning.
ella: Thanks all  will drop the Figma link in the invite and attach event schema. :sparkles:
